fnol_text: My name is Viktor McBride and I live at 632 Heather Court, Ashland, OR 97561. You can reach me on (555) 578-2882 or viktor.mcbride@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 3 November 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2025-00027. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr McBride on (555) 578-2882 to acknowledge the claim. Viktor confirmed the loss date as 3 November 2025.
Site visit to 632 Heather Court. Neighbour Lucia Jovanovic was present and confirmed the timeline.
Viktor sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
